ja185:1.1: Just as in agitated and disturbed water,
ja185:1.2: One cannot see oyster shells or (other) shellfish,
ja185:1.3: Pebbles, sand and schools of fish,
ja185:1.5: One does not see one’s own or another’s welfare.
ja185:2.1: Just as in transparent and undisturbed water,
ja185:2.2: One can see oysters and also (other) shellfish,
ja185:2.3: Pebbles, sand and schools of fish,
ja185:2.5: One sees one’s own welfare and another’s welfare.
